static_traits.name: Zhang Manshan
static_traits.family_status: Living with spouse, Has two children
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues and family once tense due to Anxiety and irritability; Has a supportive spouse
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems before; no previous psychotherapy or counseling experience
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to self-Reflect; highly cooperative (Positive attitude); tending to focus on the negative and ignore the positive in narration; significant emotional Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: I keep having the thought that 'because I no longer react as quickly as before, I will lose my job at Amazon'. It started a few months ago when struggling to meet new productivity targets; these thoughts make me Anxious and overwhelmed at Work, worrying about being fired, appearing almost daily at Work or when facing new tasks.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling now because these thoughts have started affecting my Work performance and overall physical and mental health, and I can no longer handle this Anxiety alone.
growth_experiences: A few months ago, the company set new productivity targets, and Zhang Manshan struggled to meet them, feeling her speed was not as before; subsequently, catastrophic job-loss worries frequently appeared at Work, especially intensifying when facing new tasks or high-intensity batches; the experience gradually affected her Work performance (more errors, Decreased efficiency), relationships with colleagues and family (tense due to Anxiety and irritability), and daily routines (affected Sleep and reduced focus on household tasks). Last quarter she received positive feedback for 'attention to detail', but she often ignores such positive evidence.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough, will eventually be eliminated
My worth depends on speed and youth

special_situations.event: After the company sets new productivity goals, finds them hard to meet
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot meet the new targets, it means I am not fast enough, am a burden, and will be fired sooner or later
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles efforts to increase speed and efficiency, putting all energy on 'faster'

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot adapt to new tasks immediately and maintain high speed, I will be seen as incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly Self-monitoring and nervously accelerating before and after tasks, trying to avoid mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely mess up; the supervisor will notice and then fire me

special_situations.event: Falling behind the pace when handling new batches, worrying the supervisor notices my slowness
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the supervisor sees my slowness, they will think I am a drag on the team
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring one's strengths in detail, blindly pursuing speed to mask unease
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The supervisor will decide to let me go

special_situations.event: Compares speed with colleagues and worries that age factors will make the company prefer younger employees
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as fast as younger colleagues, the company will not need me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using speed as the only measure, quickly negating positive feedback and other strengths
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; I will be eliminated

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and retained, gaining stable job security and a sense of worth
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as incompetent, Being rejected, and being fired (being eliminated)
defense_goal: Maintains control and safety through harsh self-blame and internalizing standards as high demands
Keeping excessive focus on speed and output metrics to avoid being negated

object_relations.self_representation: A not-fast-enough employee who may drag the team down
object_relations.object_representation: A judgmental supervisor or company focused only on speed, which could fire him at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When supervisors or colleagues emphasize output speed, or new tasks/new batches appear
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously seeing others as authorities who only judge by speed and may eliminate one at any time (transference: projecting the Fear of being judged/negated onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in an Empathetic and probing tone, first validating the Anxious feelings, then gently Clarifying facts and evidence; using open-ended questions to distinguish facts from speculation, avoiding confrontation and judgment.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When self-evaluation falls into the state of 'either fast enough or a failure'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding oneself and work performance in all-good/all-bad terms, ignoring the middle ground and other value dimensions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a steady tone, concretely inviting them to find gray areas and exception evidence; using comparisons and specific examples to rebuild the continuum, avoiding labeling language.

manifestations: The company's new productivity targets make them experience strong constraint from external norms, and the subjective sense of control decreases
When facing new tasks, worry about being fired intensifies; self-worth is excessively tied to speed and age
Feeling Restricted choices and responsibility pressure in Work situations, difficulty tolerating uncertainty
outcomes: Relationship tension with colleagues and family

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats 'speed' as the only correct evaluation standard (I must be faster)
Internalizes company-set indicators as absolute requirements, ignoring one's other strengths

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Constantly checking speed and errors before and after tasks, nervously accelerating
Quickly negating positive feedback and strengths (attention to detail, problem-solving)

exception_events.target_problem: When facing new tasks or high-intensity batches, the client usually catastrophically predicts being fired, with Anxiety spiking and causing errors and Decreased efficiency.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Last quarter received positive feedback for 'attention to detail', with Work contributions recognized in non-speed dimensions, showing she is not as 'undesirable' as worried.
exception_events.reason: Clue: the supervisor and team also value quality and detail; the client's years of experience and familiarity with the processes brought stable quality performance, so this time an affirmed outcome emerged.

positive_force: Attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and familiarity with procedures
Has experience supporting colleagues (can help colleagues answer questions)
Has a supportive spouse, willing to Listening and accompany
Willing to seek professional help and accept cognitive restructuring (positive attitude)
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, fortune-telling, personalization, and black-and-white thinking
Overly binds self-worth to speed and age
Highly sensitive to external evaluation, tending to negate positive feedback (seeking outside validation)
Anxiety causing sleep and Impaired concentration, Relationship tension, thereby further weakening performance

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and Catastrophizing in Work scenarios (especially facing new tasks or new batches), accompanied by more errors and Decreased efficiency
antecedent: The company setting and emphasizing new productivity targets
Being assigned new tasks or new batches appearing
Worries the supervisor will notice their 'slowness'
target_behavior.core_reason: Highly binding self-worth to speed and age, forming the belief 'if not fast enough I will be fired', and Interpreting Work situations with cognitive patterns of catastrophizing, fortune-telling, personalization, and black-and-white thinking.
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain control and avoid the potential risk of failure/being fired through excessive worry and acceleration (negative Reinforcement: using tension and Self-monitoring to escape the possibility of being seen as incompetent).
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety intensified, more errors, Decreased efficiency, further worsening Work performance and intensifying Fear of being fired; affecting sleep and family/colleague relationships.
